name: lfernandes-mods
description: Claude Code mods for everyday UX: plan limits, context, permissions, test runs, what the agent is doing, and one-click actions

plugins.name: limits-meter
plugins.description: Plan limits and context above the prompt: 5-hour and weekly windows with reset times, context fill, cache hit rate, tokens per turn

plugins.name: allowlist-coach
plugins.description: Counts permission dialogs per rule and, after repeated approvals, offers to add the rule to permissions.allow, asking before it writes

plugins.name: agent-watch
plugins.description: Subagents at a glance: tokens per agent, a toast when one stalls, and a summary naming the heaviest agent when they finish

plugins.name: test-hud
plugins.description: Test runs at a glance: passing over total in the status line, a sparkline of failures across runs, the failing tests, and a toast when the suite turns green

plugins.name: launchpad
plugins.description: A welcome menu of one-click actions under the header: each button runs an installed command, skill or agent. Pick and order up to 8 with /pad configuration
